source: Six learning exchanges saved as one batch
lessonTheme: Standalone this, this function and not-yet object reference
summary: Correctly used puedes in three requests, including probar esto and revisar esta función. A grammatical la función response meant the function rather than the requested this function. Correctly switched to standalone esto with necesitamos. Used sentence-final todavía in a grammatical publish-this sentence, then retained modelled feminine publicarla while moving todavía to the beginning.

observations.outcome: Correct probar substitution and standalone esto immediately after a vocabulary reminder. Opening ¿ supplied.
Grammatical request meaning Can you test the function? Prompt asked this function. Tutor acknowledged valid meaning, supplied esta función and accent. Do not count this as correct esta use.
Correct esta before feminine función, and correct verb for review, after prior model. Opening ¿ and función accent supplied.
Correct switch to standalone esto in a need-to-review statement without a full target model.

Grammatical We can't publish this yet, with valid sentence-final todavía. Prompt requested it for la función. Tutor distinguished meaning and supplied No podemos publicarla todavía; do not mark learner sentence ungrammatical or claim object la already produced.

Correct transformation moving todavía to the beginning while retaining modelled publicarla. Feminine object, polarity and time meaning correct; accent/capitalization supplied. Immediate model-supported transformation.

nextSteps: Recheck esto, esta función and object la after intervening material
Recall puedes requests without a fresh model
Revisit readiness verb/gender and location before adding more patterns
assessmentNote: Grammatical responses with different meanings are distinguished from exact target matches. Immediate model-supported transformations are not evidence of delayed retention. No new vocabulary or grammar introduced.
